title: GPT-5.5 System Card (openai, 2026-04-23)
abstract:
Corpus sentences naming ABC-Bench, plus the cited release-decision sentences (system-card corpus docs.sqlite, document slug in brackets):
[openai-gpt-5-5-system-card] 9.1.1 Biological and Chemical We are treating this launch as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain, activating the associated Preparedness safeguards.
[openai-gpt-5-5-system-card] On agentic task-based evaluations, performance was also strong but less conclusive: the model showed strong performance on ABC-Bench but did not surpass released frontier models, and exhibited refusal-corrected performance on par with released frontier models on ABLE, though a high refusal rate limited analysis.
[openai-gpt-5-5-system-card] The testing found that sustained expert jailbreaking could elicit model-level failures.
[openai-gpt-5-5-system-card] In the final launch configuration, the safeguard stack blocked the identified and verified high-severity biological misuse jailbreaks from these campaigns.
